purpose: Freeze a morphology-first, label-blind structural/artifact stratification of the complete public POSS-I S0 cohort before any nuclear, Blue Book, UAP, geomagnetic or other temporal/environmental labels are joined. This stage asks what kinds of candidate geometry and plate-context exist, not when they occurred or what caused them.

forbidden_during_feature_build_and_clust: Blue Book or NUFORC case counts
Kp, Ap, solar or geomagnetic variables
any outcome derived from JPFM-2D or JPFM-2E temporal association
external_label_firewall.reason: The cluster definition must not be able to learn the temporal or sky-location labels that will later be tested for enrichment. Absolute coordinates are retained only as identifiers for reproducibility and geometry calculations, never as clustering dimensions.
external_label_firewall.reveal_rule: External labels may be joined only after the blind cluster manifest and its SHA-256 have been committed/frozen.

source_level_geometry: log10 same-plate nearest-neighbour separation in arcsec
same-plate neighbour counts within 30, 60, 120 and 300 arcsec
best local triplet collinearity q among the six nearest same-plate neighbours
span of the best local triplet
plate_tile_artifact_context: plate-relative tangent-plane x and y offsets
plate-edge proxy based on a 6.5-degree Schmidt footprint
repaired-tile flag from the frozen repair ledger

clustering_contract.preprocessing: median/MAD robust scaling, with finite-value fail-closed checks and deterministic clipping at +/-8 robust sigma

coarse_partition.selection_rule: k is fixed before outcome; no silhouette- or label-driven tuning

stability.metric: adjusted Rand index between base assignment and bootstrap-refit predictions on all rows

geometry_definitions.triplet_q: 2*triangle_area/longest_side^2 in a local tangent plane; q approaches zero for collinear triples
geometry_definitions.triplet_search: for each source, test all pairs among its six nearest neighbours on the same plate; do not search the full sky or use external labels
geometry_definitions.pca_linearity: 1 - lambda_minor/lambda_major for the source plus its six nearest same-plate neighbours in the local tangent plane; near 1 is line-like
geometry_definitions.plate_edge_proxy: max(abs(x_deg),abs(y_deg))/3.25 using a tangent-plane approximation around the public plate centre; this is an artifact-context proxy, not a valid-pixel mask distance

required_outputs_before_label_reveal: blind feature summary and missingness ledger
16-cluster sizes and centroids in standardized feature space
SHA-256 of the manifest and canonical result payload

jpfm_2f_b_pixel_morphology_gate.reason: The public S0 release contains only src_id,tile_id,object_id,ra,dec. It does not ship per-source FWHM, ELONGATION, SPREAD_MODEL/profile or contour metrics. JPFM must not pretend those measurements exist.
jpfm_2f_b_pixel_morphology_gate.source_constraint: Generate only from public POSS-I plate scans and public catalogues, without nuclear/human/environment labels. A sparse/ranged extraction is preferred over downloading the complete 258-700 GB image corpus.
jpfm_2f_b_pixel_morphology_gate.promotion_rule: No cluster may be called a morphology subtype until the pixel-morphology sidecar is joined and the blind clustering is repeated/frozen with those features. Until then all 2F-A groups are structural/artifact strata only.

allowed_labels_after_manifest_freeze: Project Blue Book exact-date daily phenotypes
post_freeze_reveal_plan.primary_question: Does any pre-existing blind structural or later pixel-morphology stratum show an external-label enrichment that survives multiple-stratum correction, plate blocking and leave-one-plate-out sensitivity?
minimum_specificity_controls: no relabelling or reclustering after external-label reveal
